recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Reintroducing AuditEvent.source.identifier would conflict with the later FHIR-17413 model; future changes should be handled under a new AuditEvent.source.observer modeling issue if needed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Security issue requesting AuditEvent.source.identifier be changed from string to Identifier and the note on source.identifier be fixed.
initial_application: Historical commit 8e1a48066d applied item 7431 by changing the AuditEvent source identifier type from string to Identifier in the spreadsheet and updating examples to Identifier syntax.
additional_context: FHIR-17413 was later Published/Persuasive and explicitly changed AuditEvent.source.identifier to AuditEvent.source.observer as a Reference. Current Reference includes Reference.identifier as an Identifier logical reference, current examples use source.observer.identifier/display, and FHIR-32461/FHIR-32465 later broadened and clarified source.observer without restoring the old direct source.identifier element.
reconciliation: Created an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the current active AuditEvent source preserves the business-identifier capability through Reference.identifier and the old element name was intentionally superseded.
